definitions.explanation: An academic course that students may choose to take but is not required for graduation.

examples.japanese: {選択科目|せんたくかもく}を{三|みっ}つ{選|えら}んだ。
{選択科目|せんたくかもく}は{興味|きょうみ}のあるものを{取|と}れる。
examples.english: You can take elective courses that interest you.

examples.japanese: {選択科目|せんたくかもく}の{中|なか}から{二単位|にたんい}{以上|いじょう}{履修|りしゅう}すること。
examples.english: You must take at least two credits from the elective courses.

notes:
{選択科目|せんたくかもく} refers to courses that students can choose based on their interests. Unlike required courses, these are optional but may still be needed to complete credit requirements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選択科目|せんたくかもく}を{選|えら}ぶ (to choose electives)
- {選択科目|せんたくかもく}を{履修|りしゅう}する (to enroll in an elective)
- {自由|じゆう}{選択科目|せんたくかもく} (free elective)

RELATED WORDS:
- {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく} (required course)
- {選択|せんたく} (choice, selection)
- {選択必修|せんたくひっしゅう} (required elective - must choose from a set)
